text: My opinion is not changed. If you think of Philip Wakem as a lover again, you must give up me.” “I don’t wish it, dear Tom, at least as things are; I see that it would lead to misery. But I shall soon go away to another situation, and I should like to be friends with him again while I am here. Lucy wishes it.” The severity of Tom’s face relaxed a little. “I shouldn’t mind your seeing him occasionally at my uncle’s—I don’t want you to make a fuss on the subject.
